user_query: I want to surprise my company with some interesting news articles related to education. Can you fetch the concepts for the current customer using the Learning Engine API? Additionally, gather some country information for the schools mentioned in the news.

TaskList.description: 调用学习引擎API，获取与教育相关的新闻文章的核心概念。
提取新闻中提到的学校信息，并调用国家信息API，获取相关国家的详细信息。
